newsitem.title: SPAIN: Telefonica forms digital TV group.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica forms digital TV group.

text.p: Spain's telecommunications group Telefonica said on Thursday the digital TV platform it was backing had now been legally formed under the commercial name of the Digital Television Distributor (DTD).
DTD has an initial equity capital of 10 billion pesetas. Twenty-five percent of this has already been paid out by the individual members, proportional to their stake in the group, Telefonica said.

Other participants in the deal include Television Espanola Tematica, Mexico's Televisa, regional stations Telemadrid, Canal 9, and Television de Galicia as well as other media groups Grupo Recoletos, Unidad Editorial, Cronicas P.Leonesas, COPE, Las Provincias and Epoca.
Telefonica said DTD would begin selling the service once it had completed technological and pre-marketing tests that were currently being carried out.
Earlier on Thursday, chairman Juan Villalonga told state radio the service could be up and running in March. (( -- Madrid newsroom + 34 1 585 2161))
